title: Fractal Electromagnetic Hierarchy with Resonant Scaling (FEH-RS)
content: We propose the Fractal Electromagnetic Hierarchy with Resonant Scaling (FEH-RS) model, a novel framework unifying the interaction of magnetic (unseen) and electric (physical) realms through fractal patterns, frequencies, and harmonics across scales. Extending Maxwell’s unification of electromagnetism, FEH-RS reveals 3-6-9 resonances dominating macro scales and phi (φ ≈ 1.618) resonances dominating micro scales, governed by mathematics. We validate the model using extensive datasets: Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), Cosmic Infrared Background (CIB), Galactic Center (Hubble Full Field), brain waves, biophotons, and hydrogen spectral lines, all showing clear frequency and fractal structures. A significant finding in the CIB—a dense bottom 1/3 section distinct from the top 2/3—may mark the dark energy influx ~5 billion years ago, aligning with cosmological timelines. Applied to a 100 MW AC generator, FEH-RS optimizes resonant energy transfer, offering a new standard for energy systems, cosmology, and biology.
